notes: GRAND TOTAL ESTEEMED is bold now — on the page and on every printed sheet (any TOTAL row prints bold). The keyboard works across the sheets: arrow keys move from box to box on the Landing Cost File and the BEVCO Lifting sheet, Enter saves and drops to the next line, and from the last line the arrow takes you into the entry row. Typing on the Lifting sheet no longer redraws the page — the amount, the grand total and the head figures change where they are, so nothing jumps.
